words.gloss: the limit of what one possesses

literal: The limit of what exists without estimating, the practice of benevolence, the limit of wealth quickly will be ruined.
translation: The practice of benevolence without estimating the measure of one's own resources will quickly ruin the limits of one's wealth.
modern: தனக்கு இருக்கும் பொருளின் அளவை ஆராய்ந்து பார்க்காமல் பிறருக்கு உதவி செய்யும் தன்மையானது, ஒருவனுடைய செல்வத்தின் எல்லையை விரைவாக அழித்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against blind or disproportionate generosity. While helping others is a noble duty, practicing benevolence without first assessing the limits of one's own resources leads to financial disaster. The poet emphasizes that even substantial wealth has its limits, and unsustainable giving will quickly deplete those resources. Therefore, charity must always be balanced with realistic self-awareness of one's financial strength.
